purpose: Deterministic, ID-keyed native proof cases for Tray Studio and Windows notifications. Every entry is READY, none is PASS: the session that built Wave 2 had no real-pixel capture of QuotalisDev (screenshots BACKGROUND_ONLY, no CDP through the hardened launcher, UIA cannot address WebView2 content). See docs/validation/WAVE2_NATIVE_QA_HANDOFF.md.

controls.trayStudio: Settings -> Tray Studio tab (real persisted providerTrayConfigs; Dev app dir QuotaArc-Dev only).
controls.trayFixture: Main window URL ?window=structure-qa -> 'Tray fixture' fieldset -> Apply fixture. Backend: set_tray_qa_fixture (tray_qa_fixture.rs). In memory only; Dev channel only.
controls.notificationFixture: Main window URL ?window=structure-qa -> 'Notification fixture' fieldset -> Send toast. Backend: send_notification_qa_fixture (notification_qa_fixture.rs). Real localized copy; no history or dedupe writes; Dev channel only.
controls.appearance: Settings -> General -> Appearance Composition -> Tray row Follow/Override (set_appearance_scope).

entries.setup: Tray Studio: pin Claude only (Show this provider in the tray).
entries.passCriteria: Exactly one quotalis-provider-claude icon beside the main Quotalis icon; no duplicate after 3 settings saves.

entries.setup: Tray Studio: pin Claude, Codex, Gemini.
entries.passCriteria: Three provider icons in catalog order; each tooltip names its own provider.

entries.setup: Tray Studio: pin five enabled providers.
entries.passCriteria: Five icons, stable IDs, no orphan after unpinning one and re-pinning it.

entries.setup: Display: Tray icon mode = Per provider with more than 8 enabled providers.
entries.passCriteria: At most MAX_PROVIDER_TRAY_ICONS (8) provider icons; explicitly pinned providers present first.

entries.setup: Tray Studio: Claude, Center mark = Provider mark, style Orbit ring.
entries.passCriteria: Real Claude mark, undistorted and uncropped, inside the ring; accent only around the mark.

entries.setup: Tray Studio: Claude, Center mark = Quotalis mark.
entries.passCriteria: Obsidian Quotalis lens mark in the center; ring still measures Claude's selected limit; changing the floating Structure does not change it.

entries.setup: Style Orbit ring, Used, 62%.
entries.passCriteria: Full-circle track filled to 62% clockwise from top.

entries.setup: Style Open arc.
entries.passCriteria: 80% sweep track, filled proportionally.

entries.setup: Style Horizon bar.
entries.passCriteria: Bottom bar legible at 16px shell size.

entries.setup: Style Number badge.
entries.passCriteria: Badge digits readable or honestly illegible at 100% scale (record which).

entries.setup: Style Orbit marker.
entries.passCriteria: Hairline track with a single position dot at 62%.

entries.setup: Style Minimal mark.
entries.passCriteria: Mark only, no gauge; reading present in tooltip.

entries.setup: Used, precision 1.
entries.passCriteria: Gauge near full; tooltip reads 97.5% used.

entries.setup: Remaining, precision 1.
entries.passCriteria: Gauge near empty; tooltip reads 2.5% left (no inversion).

entries.setup: Used.
entries.passCriteria: Solid empty track (a real 0%), visibly different from W2-TRAY-UNAVAILABLE.

entries.setup: Used; repeat with Orbit marker.
entries.passCriteria: Full gauge; orbit style lights the whole track (distinct from 0%).

entries.setup: Any gauge style.
entries.passCriteria: Dashed neutral track, never a 0% gauge; tooltip reading is a dash.

entries.setup: Any gauge style.
entries.passCriteria: Same honest broken-track treatment; no stale 50% shown.

entries.setup: Tooltip limits: Session, Weekly (+ one window the provider does not supply if selectable from prior settings); name + plan on; tokens This week.
entries.passCriteria: Header 'Claude · Max 20x', one row per real window, missing window shows a dash, token line 'Local tokens 987654'; whole tooltip not cut mid-line.

entries.setup: Enable 24+ providers; hover the main Quotalis icon.
entries.passCriteria: Whole provider lines only, ending with a '+N' line; no garbled trailing characters.

entries.setup: Appearance Composition: Tray -> Follow Main Application; Quotalis logo variant Ember; indicator accent Silver.
entries.passCriteria: Gauge uses the Ember palette, not Silver; Tray Studio shows the follows-appearance note with the accent select disabled; Appearance summary reads 'Following Main Application'.

entries.setup: With 3 provider icons pinned, restart explorer.exe (Task Manager -> Windows Explorer -> Restart).
entries.passCriteria: Main and all provider icons return with their latest image and tooltip without restarting Quotalis (tray-icon 0.21.3 TaskbarCreated re-registration).

entries.setup: Windows Settings -> Personalization -> Colors -> Windows mode Light.
entries.passCriteria: Icon and track remain legible against a light taskbar; matches Tray Studio's light plate preview.

entries.setup: Windows mode Dark.
entries.passCriteria: Legible against a dark taskbar; matches the dark plate preview.

entries.setup: Left-click a provider icon.
entries.passCriteria: Settings opens on Providers with that provider selected; single process.

entries.setup: Notification fixture: Warning · high usage, provider Claude.
entries.passCriteria: Toast header/app attribution reads 'Quotalis' (Dev AUMID app.quotalis.desktop.dev); no QuotaArc/CodexBar branding.

entries.setup: Same as W2-NOTIF-IDENTITY.
entries.passCriteria: Claude mark as the toast content logo (appLogoOverride); app identity still Quotalis.

entries.setup: Language English; send Critical.
entries.passCriteria: English title/body, 94% used · 6% remaining, weekly window label.

entries.setup: ?window=structure-qa Language = Arabic; send Critical.
entries.passCriteria: Arabic copy, correct bidi for provider name and percentages, no tofu.

entries.setup: Send Informational.
entries.passCriteria: Calm session-restored copy.

entries.setup: Send Warning.
entries.passCriteria: Approaching-limit copy, no alarmist language.

entries.setup: Send Critical.
entries.passCriteria: Critical copy.

entries.setup: Send Reset completed.
entries.passCriteria: Reset copy; clicking opens the Dashboard.

entries.setup: Send Provider unavailable.
entries.passCriteria: 'Gemini could not be refreshed. Quotalis will keep trying.'; no raw error text.

entries.setup: Send Sign-in required.
entries.passCriteria: Sign-in copy only; no token, cookie, email, path or stderr text.

entries.setup: With QuotalisDev running, click the Warning toast.
entries.passCriteria: quotalis-dev://provider/claude focuses the existing process and opens the Claude pop-out; Task Manager shows one QuotalisDev.exe primary process.

entries.setup: Click the Sign-in required toast.
entries.passCriteria: Settings opens on Providers with Codex selected.

entries.setup: Let 5 refreshes run while a threshold stays crossed; separately, keep a provider failing for 5 refreshes.
entries.passCriteria: One threshold toast total; one status toast total, only after the second consecutive failure.

entries.setup: Display scale 250% then 300% (Settings -> Display -> Scale), main Quotalis icon in bar mode and in percent mode.
entries.passCriteria: Main icon edges and digits are crisp (64px source downsampled to 40/48px), no blocky enlargement; layout matches 100% appearance.

entries.setup: Display scale 150%, 200%, 300% with a Claude ring indicator pinned.
entries.passCriteria: Provider mark and ring crisp at each scale; same source policy as the main icon.

entries.setup: Display scale 100%.
entries.passCriteria: Record legibility of the 64->16px downsample for ring, bar and percent modes; note any style that becomes unreadable.

entries.setup: Open the tray flyout, move its zoom slider from 100% to 200%.
entries.passCriteria: Flyout content enlarges; notification-area icons are unchanged in size and pixels.

entries.setup: Real Dev machine with Codex local sessions; Tray Studio Codex tokens = This week; hover after the background scan (up to a few seconds).
entries.passCriteria: Tooltip line 'Local tokens · This week: N' without ≥ when the scan established coverage; with ≥ if the scan was incomplete.

entries.setup: Codex tokens = This year on a machine whose local Codex history starts after January 1.
entries.passCriteria: Reading shows ≥ (lower bound), never a plain year total.

entries.setup: Codex and Claude tokens = All available local history.
entries.passCriteria: Both readings carry ≥; selector labels mark lifetime as a lower bound.

entries.setup: Claude tokens = Today, then This month.
entries.passCriteria: Single total with ≥; no input/cached/output split anywhere; every Claude selector period labelled lower bound.

entries.setup: Tray Studio with Gemini (or any provider other than Codex/Claude) selected.
entries.passCriteria: Token selector disabled at Off with the no-local-history note; tooltip has no token line.

entries.setup: Tray fixture with tokens 18446744073, Claude, 3 long tooltip rows, name + plan, tokens = lifetime; English then Arabic.
entries.passCriteria: Token reading intact at the end of the last line; no line cut mid-way; no garbled characters.

entries.setup: Real Dev usage crossing the high then critical thresholds.
entries.passCriteria: One 'High usage alert' (Warning) and one 'Critical usage alert' (Critical) row, each 'level% → used%', no duplicates across refreshes.

entries.setup: Enable usage milestone notifications (e.g. every 10%); let usage cross one step.
entries.passCriteria: One 'Usage milestone' (Information) row per crossed step.

entries.setup: Session reaches 100%, then resets.
entries.passCriteria: One 'Session depleted' (Critical) and one 'Session restored' (Information) row.

entries.setup: Predictive pace warnings enabled; Claude or Codex pace projects exhaustion before reset.
entries.passCriteria: One 'Pace warning' (Warning) row per reset cycle with the window detail and current usage only.

entries.setup: Sign a provider out (or stop its local runtime) for 2+ refreshes, recover it, then break it again.
entries.passCriteria: Two 'Provider needs attention' rows (one per incident) with the correct detail; no values shown; no error text.

entries.setup: DeepSeek enabled across a pricing period boundary.
entries.passCriteria: One 'DeepSeek pricing changed' (Information) row with the period detail.

entries.setup: Click Open on a status row, a threshold row and a reset row.
entries.passCriteria: Status -> Settings Providers for that provider; threshold -> provider pop-out; reset -> Dashboard; single process.

entries.setup: Language Arabic; open the notification center with the rows above.
entries.passCriteria: Arabic kind, severity and detail labels; percentages and provider names isolated correctly; coverage note in Arabic.

entries.setup: Start the new Dev build on a Dev app dir that has history from the Wave 2 build.
entries.passCriteria: Existing rows and their read state remain; new kinds append after them.
